name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Both Arms

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row machine with your feet flat on the floor and your chest pressed against the chest pad. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
2. Pull both handles towards your torso by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades back.
3. Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement and slowly return the handles to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Focus on engaging your back muscles throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you return it to the starting position.

name: HAMMER STRENGTH Plate-Loaded Combination Iso-Lateral Chest - Chest Press

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Chest Press machine, back pressed against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing down.
2. Press the handles forward by extending your arms, keeping your elbows slightly bent at the end of the movement.
3. Squeeze your chest muscles at the top of the movement and slowly return the handles to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
2. Focus on engaging your chest muscles throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you press the handles forward and inhale as you return them to the starting position.

name: HAMMER STRENGTH Plate-Loaded Combination Iso-Lateral Chest - Chest Press Single Arm_Female

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Chest Press machine, back pressed against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing down.
2. Press the right handle forward by extending your arm, keeping your elbow slightly bent at the end of the movement.
3. Squeeze your chest muscles at the top of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions and then switch to your left arm and repeat.
current.tips:
1. Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
2. Focus on engaging your chest muscles throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you press the handle forward and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
